### [Touch is not one sense](../touch-journey/index.qmd)

Skin carries at least two separate systems, and they are not sending the same
message. One tells you *what* you are touching. The other answers mainly to being
touched *affectionately* — and it fires hardest at one particular speed.
:::

::: {.item}
::: {.thumb .thumb-pain}
:::

### [Pain is not a damage report](../pain-journey/index.qmd)

How much something hurts is not a reading of how damaged it is. At sixty, *88%* of
people with no back pain at all have disc degeneration on a scan — and a −20 °C rod
feels hotter under a red light than a blue one.
:::

::: {.item}
::: {.thumb .thumb-breath}
:::

### [Breathing is not a switch](../breath-journey/index.qmd)

There really is a rate at which the heart, the blood vessels and the breath fall
into step, and it is about *six breaths a minute*. Most of the rest of what gets
claimed for the breath is hope — including the part about getting more oxygen in.
:::

:::
